card.title: PlayStation 4 WLOD and BLOD Diagnostic and Troubleshooting Guide

claims.statement: If the console stays at 99mA standby current with no boot, the southbridge may be bad; check if the 32Khz crystal oscillates and replace the southbridge if missing.
claims.evidence: Current draw analysis and crystal oscillation check.
claims.quote: If it stays at 99mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is bad. Check the 32Khz crystal if it oscillates. If the 32Khz signal is missing, then replace the southbridge clean flux of the board.

claims.statement: A faulty HDMI encoder IC is the most common cause of no picture or White Light Of Death (WLOD).
claims.evidence: Diagnostic flow for WLOD and HDMI circuit inspection.
claims.quote: Most common fault is a bad HDMI encoder IC is bad most of the time you can’t measure any faults by reading diode measurements

claims.statement: If the console turns on then immediately turns itself off, and when powered on again it stays on, it indicates a bad southbridge.
claims.quote: If you turn console on and then the console turn itself off and when you try to turn on console again it powers on then you have a bad southbridge.

claims.statement: Corrupted NOR flash memory can cause BLOD; desolder the NOR chip and validate or rebuild software using the PS4 NOR Validator software.
claims.quote: Corrupted NOR software. Desolder NOR chip, validate or rebuild the software using The PS4 NOR Validator software.

claims.statement: Error CE-35888-2 indicates a Renesas IC problem in the Blu-ray drive, which is generally not repairable.
claims.quote: While the disc drive itself may be functioning, encountering this error typically indicates a Renesas IC problem, which is not repairable.

procedure: {'step': 'Check the hard drive by connecting it to a PC to rule out drive corruption causing BLOD or no display.'}
{'step': 'Inspect HDMI connector, filters, diodes, and capacitors near the HDMI circuit for damage or poor solder joints.'}
{'step': 'Test power supply by connecting the small white connector (+5Vstby) and pressing power to verify +12Von is generated.'}
{'step': 'Desolder the NOR chip and validate its contents using the PS4 NOR Validator software if software corruption is suspected.'}
{'step': 'Measure the impedance of APU and RAM capacitors to check for shorted power rails or dead components.'}
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Removing shield with hot air can cause solder near HDMI filters to bridge or lose connection.
card.caveats: Some components like the Renesas/Mediatek drive ICs are noted as non-repairable if damaged.
